layout.body:
Discover Larkhaven, where lecture halls open to cobblestone courtyards abuzz with debate and steaming coffee.
Ivy-clad dorms echo with laughter and late-night study sessions.
For students seeking a semester abroad, this vibrant town offers more than classes-it's a journey of ideas, friendships, and unforgettable experiences.
Come learn and explore.

questions.stem: Whom is the advertisement trying to attract to Larkhaven?

options.A: Adults seeking to take non-credit classes
options.C: Students wishing to study in a foreign country

questions.analysis: Whom is the advertisement trying to attract to Larkhaven? 原文依据：For students seeking a semester abroad,this vibrant town offers more than classes. 翻译：面向想要出国交换一学期的学生，这座充满活力的小镇不止提供课程学习。 选项分析： (A) Adults seeking to take non-credit classes 想要选修非学分课程的成年人 → 错误，广告面向学生，无成年人、非学分课程相关内容 (B) Older tourists on a budget 经济有限的年长游客 → 错误，全文围绕留学学习，和游客无关 (C) Students wishing to study in a foreign country 希望在国外学习的学生 → 正确，seeking a semester abroad 对应出国学习 (D) Students on summer holiday 放暑假的学生 → 错误，文中为学期留学，并非暑期度假

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes the town of Larkhaven?
questions.analysis: Which of the following best describes the town of Larkhaven? 原文依据：this vibrant town offers more than classes. 翻译：这座充满活力的小镇不止提供课程学习。 选项分析： (A) Rugged 粗犷的、崎岖的 → 错误，原文无相关描写 (B) Modern 现代化的 → 错误，文中未体现现代城市特点 (C) Sleepy 冷清安静的 → 错误，与热闹、有活力的氛围相反 (D) Lively 热闹鲜活的 → 正确，vibrant 词义与 lively 一致
